subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y6 lesson 92 (Teacher-written model letter 'Dear Year 6' from a Year 7 pupil (pupil PDF))
intro: 'Dear Year 6'. Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

passage.title: Teacher-written model letter for TGA
paras: I remember feeling nervous before Year 7, so here is my best advice. First, pack your bag the night before; mornings are busy. Second, ask questions: teachers would rather explain twice than have you stuck. Third, keep a homework planner, and actually use it! Finally, be kind to everyone, especially on the first day, because everyone is new.

questions.a: pack the night before; ask questions; keep a planner; be kind
questions.model: I do: look for the order words First, Second, Third, Finally.

questions.q: answer five VIPERS questions on the letter
questions.model: I do first: Q1 Who is the audience? Year 6 pupils about to start Year 7.

questions.q: which piece of advice is most useful to you? Explain
add one piece of advice Adam left out, with a reason
